#!/usr/bin/env bash
# jusshin — register self-hosted GitHub Actions runners as systemd services.
# rendered by nen 0.0.0-test runner script — do not edit; re-run nen runner script
#
# target:   zheref/nen
# pool:     linux-x64 (self-hosted,Linux,X64)
# runners:  NZ-NNR1, NZ-NNR2, NZ-NNR3
# identity: runner
# root:     /opt/actions-runners
# package:  actions-runner-linux-x64-2.337.0.tar.gz (runner 2.337.0)
#
# Run it as root, through sudo from your own account: sudo bash <this file>.
# config.sh runs as the service user (it refuses root), gh runs as YOU
# (SUDO_USER, with your own sign-in), and svc.sh installs the systemd unit as
# root. The registration token is minted per runner into a variable that is
# never printed, and reaches config.sh through its environment, never argv.
# Keep this file outside the runner root (e.g. ~/.local/state/nen/jusshin/).
#
# Exit codes: 0 every planned runner's service is running; 1 anything else;
# 3 run as the wrong user; 5 gh missing or not signed in; 6 the runner
# package failed its SHA-256 check (the file is deleted). The one summary
# line is also written to $PROJECT_DIR/_jusshin/register-<ts>.summary.
set -euo pipefail

TARGET='zheref/nen'
REPO_URL='https://github.com/zheref/nen'
LABELS='self-hosted,Linux,X64'
ROOT='/opt/actions-runners'
PROJECT_DIR='/opt/actions-runners/nen-runners'
DOWNLOAD_URL='https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v2.337.0/actions-runner-linux-x64-2.337.0.tar.gz'
ARCHIVE='actions-runner-linux-x64-2.337.0.tar.gz'
SHA256='70920811a4f8ad4328818682bca5c6469c1c942fab52448868071d0063816613'
SERVICE_PREFIX='actions.runner.zheref-nen.'
RUNNERS=(
  'NZ-NNR1|/opt/actions-runners/nen-runners/Runner1'
  'NZ-NNR2|/opt/actions-runners/nen-runners/Runner2'
  'NZ-NNR3|/opt/actions-runners/nen-runners/Runner3'
)
WORK_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/_jusshin"
registered=0
skipped=0
failed=0
stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
summary_file=""

# The summary file carries the ONE summary line and nothing else: it is what
# the caller reads. The log is the maintainer's.
finish() {
  summary="jusshin: ${registered} registered, ${skipped} skipped, ${failed} failed"
  echo "$summary"
  if [ -n "$summary_file" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$summary" > "$summary_file" || true; fi
  exit "$1"
}

# Whether a runner directory is already configured as NAME (idempotent re-run).
configured_as() {
  [ -f "$1/.runner" ] && grep -q "\"agentName\": *\"$2\"" "$1/.runner"
}

# Why a directory configured as NAME is stale, or nothing when it stands: its
# service is absent ($2 is not 1), or GitHub no longer lists its registration
# ($3, one name per line) (#319).
stale_reason() {
  local reasons=""
  if [ "$2" != 1 ]; then reasons="its service is absent"; fi
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$3" | grep -Fxq -- "$1"; then
    reasons="${reasons:+$reasons and }GitHub no longer lists its registration"
  fi
  printf '%s' "$reasons"
}

# The names GitHub lists for the repository's runners, read once into
# $listed; $listed_ok is 1 when the read succeeded.
listed=""
listed_ok=""
read_listed() {
  if [ -n "$listed_ok" ]; then return 0; fi
  if listed="$(gh_run api --paginate "repos/$TARGET/actions/runners" --jq '.runners[].name' 2>/dev/null)"; then listed_ok=1; else listed_ok=0; fi
}

# Stop and uninstall a stale runner's service from its own directory.
remove_service() {
  (cd "$1" && { ./svc.sh stop || true; } && ./svc.sh uninstall)
}

SERVICE_USER='runner'

if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "jusshin: run as root (sudo bash $0) -- this script installs systemd services."
  finish 3
fi
if [ -z "${SUDO_USER:-}" ] || [ "$SUDO_USER" = root ]; then
  echo "jusshin: run through sudo from your own account -- gh runs as that account (SUDO_USER), with its own sign-in."
  finish 3
fi
as_invoker() { sudo -u "$SUDO_USER" -H "$@"; }
gh_run() { as_invoker gh "$@"; }
service_present() { [ -n "$(systemctl list-unit-files "${SERVICE_PREFIX}$1.service" --no-legend 2>/dev/null)" ]; }
if ! as_invoker gh --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "jusshin: gh is not on PATH for $SUDO_USER. Install the GitHub CLI and re-run."
  finish 5
fi
if ! as_invoker gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "jusshin: 'gh auth status' failed for $SUDO_USER. Run 'gh auth login' and re-run."
  finish 5
fi
if ! id -u "$SERVICE_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "jusshin: the service user $SERVICE_USER does not exist. Create it (useradd --system --create-home $SERVICE_USER) and re-run."
  finish 1
fi

mkdir -p "$ROOT" "$PROJECT_DIR" "$WORK_DIR"
chmod 0755 "$ROOT" "$PROJECT_DIR"
log="$WORK_DIR/register-$stamp.log"
summary_file="$WORK_DIR/register-$stamp.summary"
exec > >(tee -a "$log") 2>&1
echo "jusshin: ${#RUNNERS[@]} runner(s) for $TARGET; log $log"

pending=()
replace_names=" "
for entry in "${RUNNERS[@]}"; do
  name="${entry%%|*}"
  dir="${entry#*|}"
  if configured_as "$dir" "$name"; then
    # Configured is not standing (#319): a failed service install leaves .runner
    # behind with no service, and a removed registration leaves one GitHub no
    # longer lists. Either is stale -- emptied and re-registered, never skipped.
    read_listed
    if [ "$listed_ok" != 1 ]; then
      echo "jusshin: could not list the runners of $TARGET, so $name in $dir cannot be told live from stale -- left untouched."
      failed=$((failed + 1))
      continue
    fi
    has_service=0
    if service_present "$name"; then has_service=1; fi
    reason="$(stale_reason "$name" "$has_service" "$listed")"
    if [ -z "$reason" ]; then
      echo "jusshin: $name is already configured in $dir -- skipped."
      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
      continue
    fi
    echo "jusshin: $name in $dir is stale ($reason) -- emptied and re-registered."
    if [ "$has_service" = 1 ] && ! remove_service "$dir"; then
      echo "jusshin: svc.sh could not uninstall the stale service for $name; $dir left untouched."
      failed=$((failed + 1))
      continue
    fi
    rm -rf "$dir"
    # A stale runner GitHub still lists is replaced under its own name.
    if printf '%s\n' "$listed" | grep -Fxq -- "$name"; then replace_names="$replace_names$name "; fi
    pending+=("$entry")
    continue
  fi
  if [ -f "$dir/.runner" ]; then
    echo "jusshin: $dir holds a runner configured as another name, not $name -- left untouched."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  pending+=("$entry")
done

archive="$WORK_DIR/$ARCHIVE"
verify_archive() {
  echo "$SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1
}
if [ "${#pending[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$archive" ] || ! verify_archive; then
    echo "jusshin: downloading $ARCHIVE"
    curl -fsSL -o "$archive" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"
    if ! verify_archive; then
      rm -f "$archive"
      echo "jusshin: $ARCHIVE failed its SHA-256 check (expected $SHA256) -- deleted."
      finish 6
    fi
  fi
  echo "jusshin: $ARCHIVE verified (sha256 $SHA256)."
fi

for entry in "${pending[@]+"${pending[@]}"}"; do
  name="${entry%%|*}"
  dir="${entry#*|}"
  echo "jusshin: registering $name in $dir"
  install -d -o "$SERVICE_USER" -m 0755 "$dir"
  # Re-hashed immediately before EVERY extraction, not only after the download.
  if ! verify_archive; then
    rm -f "$archive"
    echo "jusshin: $ARCHIVE no longer matches sha256 $SHA256 -- deleted; nothing extracted into $dir."
    finish 6
  fi
  sudo -u "$SERVICE_USER" tar xzf "$archive" -C "$dir"
  token="$(as_invoker gh api -X POST "repos/$TARGET/actions/runners/registration-token" --jq .token 2>/dev/null)" || token=""
  if [ -z "$token" ]; then
    echo "jusshin: could not mint a registration token for $name; the gh user must be an admin of $TARGET."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  # NO TOKEN ON A COMMAND LINE (/proc/<pid>/cmdline is world-readable): it
  # reaches config.sh as ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_TOKEN, which actions/runner reads
  # as its --token input. printf is a builtin (no argv), and the service user's
  # shell reads it from stdin into its own environment -- sudo would strip an
  # inherited variable, and 'env VAR=...' would put it back on argv.
  replace=()
  case "$replace_names" in *" $name "*) replace=(--replace) ;; esac
  if ! (cd "$dir" && printf '%s\n' "$token" | sudo -u "$SERVICE_USER" bash -c 'IFS= read -r ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_TOKEN; export ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_TOKEN; exec ./config.sh --unattended --url "$1" --name "$2" --labels "$3" --work _work "${@:4}"' jusshin "$REPO_URL" "$name" "$LABELS" ${replace[@]+"${replace[@]}"}); then
    token=""
    echo "jusshin: config.sh failed for $name."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  token=""
  if ! (cd "$dir" && ./svc.sh install "$SERVICE_USER" && ./svc.sh start && ./svc.sh status); then
    echo "jusshin: svc.sh could not install or start the service for $name."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  registered=$((registered + 1))
done

down=0
for entry in "${RUNNERS[@]}"; do
  name="${entry%%|*}"
  if ! systemctl is-active --quiet "${SERVICE_PREFIX}${name}.service"; then
    echo "jusshin: ${SERVICE_PREFIX}${name}.service is not active."
    down=$((down + 1))
  fi
done
systemctl list-units "${SERVICE_PREFIX}*" --all --no-pager || true

if [ "$down" -eq 0 ] && [ "$failed" -eq 0 ]; then finish 0; fi
finish 1
